motif.name: Escape
motif.description: Passages of the piano score that match one melody, in levels by how close they are to it. Level 1 is the closest. A run of repeated notes counts as one note. Passages that overlap, or lie within 1 measure of each other, are joined into one; the level is that of the closest.

source.author: J. K. Holman
source.title: Wagner's Ring: A Listener's Companion & Concordance
source.publication: Portland, Oregon: Amadeus Press, 1996; paperback 2003, ISBN 978-1-57467-070-7

levels.label: Original
levels.name: The melody as given
levels.description: The melody as you gave it. It is not a passage of the score.

levels.name: Closest to the original
levels.description: The best partial matches of the whole phrase. The pitches and the rhythm are the same, in any octave.

levels.name: Same core pitches
levels.description: Notes 1 to 13 of the phrase have the same pitches, in any octave, but the rhythm differs. In a sung passage the score may have one short extra note between two of them: it is skipped.

levels.name: One note different
levels.description: Notes 1 to 13 of the phrase have the same pitches, in any octave, except one note. The rhythm may differ.

levels.name: Other keys
levels.description: Notes 1 to 13 of the phrase have the same intervals, moved to another key, in any octave. The rhythm may differ.

levels.name: Opening, other keys
levels.description: Only the first notes, 1 to 9 of the phrase, have the same intervals, moved to another key. The rhythm may differ. Short cells also match by chance, so some of these passages are coincidences.

occurrences.label: The original
occurrences.note: The melody as you gave it, engraved from your notes. It starts with a pickup of one quarter note, the bars are in 4/4, and the score has a treble clef and three sharps in the key signature. It is not a passage of the score.

occurrences.label: First 9 notes, another key
occurrences.note: Your notes 1 to 9 (of 13) have the same intervals here, in another key: your F♯ becomes G, which is 1 semitone up or 11 down. The rhythm differs. In eighth notes, the score plays them as 3 1 3 5/2 1/2 5 3 1/2; yours are 2 4 3 1 4 2 2 4.

libretto.text: Greife nur zu und grause dich nicht:
libretto.translation: Just take hold and do not be afraid:

libretto.text: in der Flut entflieh'n wir nicht leicht:
libretto.translation: in the flood we do not escape easily:
(a wordless cry)
